chart-elder.scope: Chart figures and their legends only.

chart-government.scope: Chart figures and their legends only.

headline-lg.purpose: The page H1, one per page; on the need page it sits inside the first fieldset's legend.

headline-md.purpose: Category headings on the all-services page, each under a 3px Deep Civic Green rule.

headline-sm.purpose: Section H2s and the service name that heads each result.

title-lg.purpose: Service names on the all-services page.

title-sm.purpose: H3s inside a result (仲要核實, 下一步); body size, bold.

wordmark.purpose: 香港社福導航 in the header band.

lead.purpose: The one-line promise under the H1 and the 你揀咗 summary on results.

body.purpose: Everything else; the 46rem column holds about 37 CJK characters per line.

phone.purpose: Tap-to-call numbers, tabular figures, grouped with a space, never wrapping.

label.purpose: Tags, the phase tag, table column heads, flow step numerals, the chart's column heads.

nav.purpose: Top menu items; 1rem at 40rem and below.

data.purpose: Data-table cells and chart rows, with tabular figures.

shadows.name: button-base-edge
shadows.purpose: Primary button at rest and on hover; removed on press, with transform: translateY(2px). The only shadow at rest.

shadows.name: button-focus-edge
shadows.purpose: The base edge turns black while the button has keyboard focus.

shadows.name: focus-underline
shadows.purpose: Links and a focused choice's label: extends the yellow fill upward and draws a 4px black underline.

breakpoints.name: stack
breakpoints.purpose: At and below: primary button full width; calls-list rows stack the number under its label; top menu gap 1rem and 16px type.

breakpoints.name: menu-grid
breakpoints.purpose: At and below: the top menu becomes a three-column grid.

narrative.overview:
This is the category standard played straight: a public-service website at the craft level of GOV.UK, the NHS website and 社署長者資訊網, written in Hong Kong Traditional Chinese for worried family carers, frontline social workers and older people reading on phones. The visitor walks up to a counter, says the need in everyday words, and leaves with a service that may fit, what still has to be confirmed, and a number to call. Nothing on the page competes with that handover.

The world is white paper and black ink, one deep civic green band across the top with a plain text menu under it, blue underlined links, a single green start button, and yellow keyboard focus. Containers are square, flat and bordered; urgency, notices and eligibility are told by full-border tinted panels, never by shadow or ornament. Where a number matters, it is said as a table or a plain bar chart, never as an infographic. Type is the reader's own system CJK sans in two weights, with a large 19px body. Density is low: one column, one task per screen, more space above a heading than below it.

Familiar beats distinctive here, on purpose: the familiarity is the trust signal. The system borrows the canon's grammar (phase banner, yellow-and-black focus, the button's pressable base edge, bordered panels) but never any government's crest, wordmark or header colour. The deep green band is this site's own.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, black text, one deep green header band closed by a lighter jade stripe, then a white text menu whose current page is ink with a green underbar.
One primary action per screen: a square green button with a 2px base edge, full width on phones.
Links are always blue and underlined; visited links turn violet.
Every keyboard focus is a yellow fill with a black underline or ring.
Full-border tinted panels: red for 急事, blue for what must be confirmed or assessed, green for who qualifies.
Key facts are bold with a green underline, so they never read as blue links.
Phone numbers are large, bold, tabular and always tappable.
System CJK sans, weights 400 and 700 only, 19px body.
Flat and square: no radius on any container or control, no depth shadows, no transitions. The only curves are native radios, the numbered step marker, and the chart's data marks.

rules.name: The Yellow Means Focus Rule
rules.body: Focus Yellow appears only where the keyboard has put the visitor. It is never decoration, a highlighter mark or a brand accent.

rules.name: The Two Greens Rule
rules.body: Deep Civic Green names the site; Start Green means "press this". Start Green fills the primary button and nothing else; its one other use is the underline of a key fact, never a fill.

rules.name: The Chart-Only Rule
rules.body: Elder Share Green and Government Share Blue live inside chart figures only. They never fill a panel, a tag, a button or text, and the chart's 2px and 4px radii never leave the chart either.

rules.name: The Colour Never Alone Rule
rules.body: Every coloured signal also carries words or form: the urgent panel has a heading, tags are text, links are underlined, focus adds a black underline or ring to the yellow.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: 400 and 700 only. Emphasis is weight or size, or the key-fact underline; never text colour or letter-spacing.

rules.name: The Key Not Link Rule
rules.body: A key fact is bold ink with a green underline; a link is blue with a blue underline. Never colour a key fact blue, and never leave a link un-underlined, so the two can never be confused.

rules.name: The Sixteen-Pixel Floor Rule
rules.body: Body is 19px, and nothing on any page is set below 16px, including hints, source lines and the footer.

rules.name: The Readable Number Rule
rules.body: Phone numbers are grouped with a space (2343 2255, 182 183), bold, 21px, tabular, and never wrap mid-number.

rules.name: The One Column Rule
rules.body: Every page is a single column at every width. No sidebars, no card grids, no multi-column content beyond the services table of contents, the narrow-screen menu grid, and data tables whose columns are the data.

rules.name: The One Start Rule
rules.body: A page carries at most one green button, and it is that screen's single forward action (由需要開始, 睇結果). Every other route is a text link.

rules.name: The Flat Counter Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. No element other than the primary button takes a zero-blur shadow, and nothing takes a soft drop shadow at all.

rules.name: The Full Border Rule
rules.body: A panel signals by its whole border plus a tint. A panel never carries a one-sided stripe.

rules.name: The Scoped Curve Rule
rules.body: Rounding belongs to data marks and markers, never to containers: a panel, button, tag, table or flow step is always square.

dos: Do keep every page a single 46rem column with 16px gutters, checked at 320px and 200% zoom.
Do set body copy at 19px (1.1875rem) on a 1.6 line height, and keep every piece of text at 16px or above.
Do give every focusable element the Focus Yellow fill with a black underline or ring; never remove a focus style.
Do end every result and every urgent panel with a calls list whose numbers are tel: links at least 44px tall.
Do show urgency and notices as full-border tinted panels: 3px Urgent Brick Red on Urgent Wash, 3px Notice Blue on Notice Wash.
Do keep links Public Link Blue and underlined, Visited Violet once visited.
Do close every service fact with a Small Slate source line naming the official page and its check date.
Do use at most one Start Green button per screen, full width at 40rem and below.
Do mark the current page in the top menu with `aria-current="page"`, ink text and the 4px Deep Civic Green underbar.
Do mark a key fact with bold and the Start Green underline, keeping it visibly different from a blue link.
Do state eligibility in the green threshold panel as a ticked checklist, first on every service page.
Do print every charted value as a number in the chart's own table, and keep the 2px gap between series.
donts: Don't round corners on any container or control; the system radius is 0. The 2px swatch and 4px bar-end radii belong to the chart, and the circle to the flow's step marker.
Don't add soft drop shadows, glows or raised cards; the 2px base edge belongs to the primary button alone.
Don't use Focus Yellow or Start Green as decoration, or the chart colours outside a chart.
Don't mark a panel with a one-sided stripe; its border goes all the way round.
Don't add a third font weight or a second typeface.
Don't lay services out as an icon-tile or card grid; they read as one column of headed entries, each linking to its own page.
Don't put a kicker or eyebrow label above a heading; tags sit below the heading they describe.
Don't signal with colour alone; every coloured state also carries words, an underline or a ring.
Don't copy any government's crest, wordmark or header colour; borrow the canon's patterns, never its identity.
